name: DULOXETINE 60MG 14 CAPSULES OR TABLETS DELAYED RELEASE
description: Duloxetine 60 mg, in delayed-release capsules and a 14-unit presentation, is an antidepressant and serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI). It is available under various brand names. A prescription is required for its sale.
